senses.gloss:
ओष्ठ ओष्ठ, i. e. probably अव-स्थ (vb. स्था), m.
 1. The lip, Man. 8, 282.
 2. The upper lip, Bhāg. P. 4, 8, 46. In comp. words a preceding अ may be dropped, and the fem. of a comp. adj. may end in ठा or ठी, e. g. रुचिर-दन्तौष्ठी, Having beautiful teeth and lips, Rām. 3, 52, 16.
 बिम्बोष्ठ, adj. Having bimba-like lips, Kathās. 4, 8.
 संदष्टौष्ठ, i. e. सम्-दष्ट-ओष्ठ [] (vb. दंश्), adj. Biting the lips, MBh. 3, 427.
 स्फुरदोष्ठ, i. e. स्फुरन्त्-ओष्ठ, adj., f. ठी, With trembling lips, Indr. 5, 51.
